paragraphs.text: Cicatrice , also known as the Savage Lands , is a wild and dangerous area of Jund .

The savage lands of Cicatrice are a region of especially rugged land, knuckled and twisted between two great rift valleys. Called scar-lands by the tribes that live in this extreme terrain, Cicatrice is home to one of the most powerful of Jund 's dragons , a red-scaled, tattered-winged monstrosity whose shadow blots out the sun and casts her quarry into darkness. She has several nests here but keeps her main hoard in an obsidian basin ringed with talonlike spikes.
